patch_description: Crossover combining the best-performing prior program (seed screening with cheap soft-min runs, promoting only the top seeds to full optimization — this gave score 0.80 at only 4.71s) with the group-move Phase 2 (2-4 coordinated point perturbations) and paired-coordinate Phase 3 polish from the other variants, which help escape single-point plateaus. I also keep the expanded seed pool (perturbed lattice variants and a second Dirichlet sample) so screening has more diverse basins to choose from, while the screening filter keeps total runtime low. Determinism is preserved via fixed seeds everywhere.
